description_en: Specifies whether a source IP address can access the assets to which a control policy applies
description_zh: 配置来源IP是否可以访问当前策略生效的主机
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost set-policy-ip-acl-config --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 3 --ip-acl-config '{"AclType":"white","IPs":["1.1.1.1"]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolicyIPAclConfig

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the DescribeInstances operation to query the bastion host ID.[](~~153281~~)
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。

Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to modify.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query the control policy ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要修改的控制策略ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

fields.help_en:
The mode of access control on source IP addresses. Valid values:

black: blacklist mode.

white: whitelist mode
fields.help_zh:
来源IP限制模式。取值：

black：黑名单模式
white：白名单模式
fields.name: acl_type

fields.help_en:
The source IP addresses in the blacklist or whitelist.



This parameter is required if AclType is set to white.

If AclType is set to black but you do not want to add IP addresses to the blacklist, you can leave IPs empty
fields.help_zh:
来源IP限制列表。

AclType 设置为 white 时，IPs列表内容必填。
AclType 设置为black 但暂不需要设置来源IP黑名单时，IPs请传空列表
fields.name: ips

parameters.help_en: The access control settings for source IP addresses
parameters.name: ip_acl_config

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
